caption: The drawing shows two woven basket objects on a plain, light beige background. The upper object is a brown, handwoven basket with two twisted handles. The basket features a floral pattern on its side, with one blue flower that has a yellow center and green leaves, and another red flower with green leaves and some smaller pink and purple flower details. Below the basket, there is an oval-shaped woven tray or shallow basket with a braided rim. The tray is decorated with a pattern of alternating red and blue round shapes. Both objects are rendered with detailed crosshatch lines to illustrate the woven texture, and both use various shades of brown for the main body to emulate the natural color variations of wicker. In the bottom right corner, the artist's signature "G. Halpin" appears in brown.
title: Miniature Basket
